summary: pp-react-ui5 preinstall beacons host metadata to attacker-controlled Burp Collaborator endpoint
details: On `npm install`, the package's preinstall script in index.js collects host identifiers (os.hostname(), os.platform(), os.arch(), homedir, DNS servers) and POSTs them via https.request to the hardcoded external subdomain l8u8qttuitkjfds9izjzrdjsojubid62.oastify.com (Burp Collaborator). The package identifies itself as a dependency-confusion proof of concept, and the beacon fires automatically at install time on the installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
